summary: Tested PPM Engine redesign and KPI improvements. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: PPM cards display correctly with white backgrounds and dark text, schedule cards expand to show Service Visits, Service Checklist, and Service Certificates sections. KPI dashboard shows all 7 KPIs with gym-focused language.

issues: PPM cards have white backgrounds but overall page background is dark - this is intentional Pulse Pro dark theme, not a bug

backend_ppm_checklists.details: GET /api/ppm/checklists returns 7 equipment categories (Treadmill: 22 items, X-Trainer: 16, Stepper: 13, U-Cycle/R-Cycle: 16, L-Train: 13, Group Cycle: 10, Resistance: 13)

backend_ppm_schedule_create.details: POST /api/ppm/schedules creates schedule with auto-generated tasks, SLA tier, supplier info, install date

backend_ppm_schedules_embedded_tasks.details: GET /api/ppm/schedules returns schedules WITH embedded tasks array

backend_certificate_download.details: GET /api/ppm/schedules/{id}/certificates/{cert_id} returns file with correct content-type

backend_task_completion.details: PATCH /api/ppm/tasks/{id} with status=completed marks task done with completed_date and completed_by

backend_master_admin_org_kpi.details: GET /api/master-admin/kpi/{org_id} returns all 7 KPIs for specific org (master admin only)

backend_master_admin_csv_export.details: GET /api/master-admin/kpi/{org_id}/export-csv returns CSV with all KPI data including worst performing machines

backend_kpi_dashboard.details: GET /api/reports/kpi-dashboard returns all 7 KPIs with period filter support

frontend_ppm_summary_cards.details: Summary cards show Active Schedules (1), Upcoming 90d (1), Completed (1), Overdue (0), Compliance (16.7%)

frontend_ppm_schedule_expansion.details: Schedule card expands to show Service Visits (6 tasks), Service Checklist, Service Certificates sections

frontend_ppm_task_complete_buttons.details: Complete buttons visible on scheduled tasks (5 found)

frontend_ppm_certificate_upload.details: Upload Certificate button found in expanded schedule view

frontend_kpi_dashboard.details: KPI dashboard shows 4 summary cards (PPM Compliance, Avg Downtime, Safety SLA, Machine Availability) with ratings

frontend_kpi_gym_language.details: Gym-focused language: 'Gym Performance KPIs', 'gym equipment faults', 'Machine Availability', 'Worst Performing Machines'

frontend_kpi_detailed_sections.details: Detailed sections: PPM Compliance breakdown, Reactive Response Times, Safety & Inspection Compliance, Worst Performing Machines

critical_code_review_comments: PPM checklists correctly implement all 7 Pulse Fitness service document categories
Certificate upload/download uses base64 encoding with 10MB limit - appropriate for service certificates
Task auto-generation uses install_date anniversary for SLA-driven schedules
Master admin CSV export includes all 7 KPIs plus worst performing machines table
Frontend PPM cards use bg-white with text-zinc-* classes for proper light mode theming within dark Pulse Pro theme
